Sections.title: General Map and Report Review
Sections.subtitle: Florida baseline; apply data-related items to the work performed.

items.title: Purpose and Scope
items.statement: Identify the product type and intended purpose.

items.title: Horizontal Control and Accuracy
items.statement: State the horizontal datum and control; retain independent accuracy checks and methods.

items.title: Vertical Control and Accuracy
items.statement: For elevation data, state datum and control and document accuracy and verification methods.

items.title: Assumed Datum Control
items.statement: If using an assumed datum, distinguish it from published datums and provide reproducible control.

items.title: Dated Supporting Records
items.statement: Retain dated measurements and computations supporting the product.

items.title: Responsible Surveyor and Business
items.statement: Show responsible surveyor name/license and issuing business name, authorization number, and street/mailing addresses.

items.title: Acquisition and Revision Dates
items.statement: Identify the last acquisition date and subsequent graphic revision dates.

items.title: Signature and Seal Statement
items.statement: Include the required original-signature/seal validity statement unless electronically signed and sealed.

items.title: Map Orientation and Legend
items.statement: Show north, scale, defined survey abbreviations, and the bearing reference to an established monumented line.

items.title: Mapped Feature Responsibility
items.statement: Identify responsibility for mapped features and integration of others' work.

items.title: Final Delivery Review
items.statement: Confirm signed/sealed deliverables, sheet references, filenames, revision consistency, and contracted formats before release.

items.title: Tree Survey Limits
items.statement: Confirm survey limits, adjoining coverage, included tree classes, and inventory date.

items.title: Tree Inclusion Criteria
items.statement: Verify species, size thresholds, protected-tree definitions, and measurement methods with the applicable jurisdiction; record the criteria used.

items.title: Unique Tree Identifiers
items.statement: Check each mapped tree has a unique identifier matching field tags and the inventory; resolve missing or duplicate tags.

items.title: Tree Positions
items.statement: Verify surveyed trunk locations and reconcile closely spaced trees, clusters, and multi-stem trees.

items.title: Inventory Attributes
items.statement: Check required species, diameter units/measurement height, multi-stem convention, and other contracted attributes for completeness.

items.title: Specialist-Supplied Attributes
items.statement: Identify the source and date of arborist-supplied species, condition, or preservation assessments; resolve discrepancies.

items.title: Unobserved or Inaccessible Trees
items.statement: Document excluded areas, inaccessible trees, missing tags, and assumptions requiring follow-up.

items.title: Inventory-to-Map Reconciliation
items.statement: Reconcile tree counts and identifiers between observations, map symbols, labels, and tabular inventory.

items.title: Canopy and Protection Areas
items.statement: Distinguish measured canopy data from supplied or calculated protection zones and identify their source.

items.title: Tree Submission Details
items.statement: Verify required schedules, protected-tree labels, preservation/removal classifications, and supporting specialist documents.

items.title: Tree Deliverable Consistency
items.statement: Compare PDF, CAD, and inventory exports for IDs, units, coordinate locations, and revision agreement.
